name: Wiki.js
description: Modern wiki with a Markdown and WYSIWYG editor, git sync and granular permissions (compose stack with Postgres).

ru.description: Современная вики с редакторами Markdown и WYSIWYG, синхронизацией с git и гибкими правами (compose-стек с Postgres).

composeYaml:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: wiki
      POSTGRES_USER: wiki
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  wiki:
    image: ghcr.io/requarks/wiki:2
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - db
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      DB_TYPE: postgres
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_NAME: wiki
      DB_USER: wiki
      DB_PASS: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - wikidata:/wiki/data/content
volumes:
  pgdata:
  wikidata:
